questions.stem: Silicon is classified as a metalloid. Why is it useful in electronics?

options.text: It is a very good conductor like copper
It is a semiconductor whose conductivity can be controlled
It is completely non-conductive and acts as an insulator
It is magnetic and can store data

questions.explanation: Silicon is a semiconductor, meaning its electrical conductivity is between that of metals and insulators. Its conductivity can be increased by heating or by doping with impurities. This tuneable conductivity makes it the basis of computer chips and the entire electronics industry.
